name: S1_baseballr_data
provenance: fetched per-season via api.github.com git-blobs into data/raw/baseballr (blob SHAs recorded in data/raw/FETCH_MANIFEST.json). REGULAR SEASON 2015-2026 trusted (2019-2025 independently cross-verified via S2: date+team join with zero mismatches and 100% outcome agreement). POSTSEASON 2015-2025 also trusted: its World Series rows reproduce all 11 independently documented champions and series lengths exactly (see KNOWN_WS_CHAMPIONS). The 2026-09-20 claim that this source's postseason was fabricated was wrong — it was caused by an incorrect champion table, not by the data.
data_type: games, scores, venues, series, at-bats, pitchers, batters
description: MLB schedule + play-by-play parquet, 1988-2026 (2026 live through 2026-09-20)
historical_depth: games, scores, venues, series, at-bats, pitchers, batters

name: S2_cesar_odds
provenance: cloned into data/raw/odds. 15,442 rows joined with 0 mismatches. NO verified market prices exist for any 2019-2025 postseason game -> PO ROI is reported as a labeled fair-coin proxy, not real market ROI.
data_type: 2019-2025 REGULAR SEASON ONLY (verified: 2021 file ends 2021-09-27; no postseason odds in any year)
description: Real moneyline odds (American) + outcomes + statcast form features
historical_depth: 2019-2025 REGULAR SEASON ONLY (verified: 2021 file ends 2021-09-27; no postseason odds in any year)

name: S3_statsapi_mirror
provenance: dates/teams match S1 schedule for all 440 pks. NOTE: the earlier claim that a '2016 WS' dump showed a game that never occurred was wrong — 2016-10-25 Cubs@Indians was World Series Game 1 and did occur. Still not used for settlement (null scores).
data_type: 440 postseason dumps fetched by game_pk into data/raw/statsapi
historical_depth: 440 postseason dumps fetched by game_pk into data/raw/statsapi
reject_reason: NOT an independent source: same mirror family as S1; all 440 dumps carry null scores, so they corroborate dates/teams only
